name: Claude
mood: Warm parchment editorial AI-product system with ink-like near-black text, Anthropic Serif headings, calm sans UI, rounded paper cards, and clay as decorative-only punctuation.

boneParchment.role: Page canvas, large backgrounds, nav bar, and secondary cards.

paperWhite.role: Elevated cards and primary content surfaces above the canvas.

softStone.role: Nested cards, subtle surface variation, and alternate section bands.

carbonInk.role: Primary text, headings, icon fills, and dark buttons.

graphite.role: Secondary headings, button text, nav text, and inline links.

ashen.role: Helper text, captions, fine print, and disclaimer copy.

pebble.role: Tertiary text, copyright, and low-priority labels.

mist.role: Hairline nav dividers, input borders, and subtle rules.

chalk.role: Soft border lines, illustration fills, and pale background tints.

obsidian.role: Footer background only; avoid for body text.

clay.role: Decorative marks, icons, dots, and illustration details only.

fallbacks.display: Source Serif 4, Charter, Georgia, ui-serif, serif
fallbacks.body: Inter, IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

rules: Use Anthropic Serif only for display and editorial headings.
Use Anthropic Sans for all functional UI, body, labels, buttons, links, cards, and forms.
Keep most sans text between 400 and 580.
Do not use 700 or heavier weights.

components.name: Filled Dark Button
components.recipe: Carbon Ink fill, Bone Parchment or Paper White text, 8px radius, 8px vertical and 20px horizontal padding, Anthropic Sans 15px/500.

components.name: Pill Navigation Button
components.recipe: Transparent background, Graphite text, no border, 8px radius, Anthropic Sans 15px/500.

components.name: Pricing Tier Card
components.recipe: Paper White on Bone Parchment, 24px radius, 32px padding, serif plan heading, sans price and description, optional soft hover shadow.

components.name: Feature Benefit Card
components.recipe: Soft Stone or Paper White, 16px radius, 24px to 32px padding, Carbon Ink icon, 14px Graphite body.

components.name: Editorial Section Header
components.recipe: Anthropic Serif 30px/400, Carbon Ink, line-height 1.2, followed by short Ashen or Graphite sans copy.

components.name: Footer Band
components.recipe: Full-width Obsidian footer with muted Pebble links and compact 14px sans columns.

components.name: Inline Link
components.recipe: Graphite default, Carbon Ink hover, underline for clarity, no Clay or blue link color.

components.name: Input Field
components.recipe: Transparent or Paper White fill, 1px Mist border, 8px radius, 14px Anthropic Sans, soft focus ring.

components.name: FAQ Accordion Item
components.recipe: Hairline-separated item, Graphite question, Carbon Ink answer, 24px vertical padding, sans only.

components.name: Clay Accent Mark
components.recipe: Small Clay dot, ornament, icon detail, or illustration mark; decorative and non-interactive.

components.name: Status Badge
components.recipe: 11px to 12px sans label, 8px radius, low-contrast warm-gray background, monochrome treatment.

do: Use Bone Parchment as the page canvas.
Use Anthropic Serif 24px to 30px at weight 400 for editorial headings.
Keep Anthropic Sans mostly between 400 and 580.
Use Paper White cards over Bone Parchment for a layered paper effect.
Use Clay only for small decorative marks.
Use 24px radius for elevated cards and 16px for nested cards.
Use 8px radius for buttons, inputs, and nav controls.
dont: Do not use Clay for button fills, links, or major CTA surfaces.
Do not use pure black for body text.
Do not set headings at 700 or heavier.
Do not use cool blue, green, or red as brand accents.
Do not set large display headings in Anthropic Sans.
